recent_changes.description: Phase 06: Added referral seed data (codes, logs, rewards, boosts, redemptions). Fixed seed.ts to use PrismaPg adapter (Prisma 7 requirement). Implemented hybrid SQL boost sorting in /api/intents. Fixed TS errors (RewardCard nullable stock, register Suspense boundary). npm run build passes.

errors_encountered.error: Prisma 7 PrismaClient constructor rejects datasourceUrl and datasources options
errors_encountered.solution: seed.ts must create its own PrismaPg adapter from Pool, then pass { adapter } to PrismaClient — matching lib/db.ts pattern.
Changed !== null to != null to cover both null and undefined.

errors_encountered.error: useSearchParams() requires Suspense boundary in Next.js 16
errors_encountered.solution: Split RegisterPage into RegisterForm (inner) + RegisterPage (wrapper with Suspense).

decisions_made.reason: Prisma ORM cannot do CASE WHEN...LEFT JOIN ordering. Use raw SQL for ID selection, then Prisma findMany for hydration. Keeps frontend API contract unchanged.
Cannot import lib/db.ts from seed context (Next.js module system issues). Standalone PrismaPg adapter creation is simpler and more reliable.
Standardized and easy to configure for dashboard metrics.
